subject: frame_bench: needs one 3-5 min clang -O2 slot (jobs1)
body: Tooling ready: gpu/tools/frame_model.py (device-log fit + what-if scenarios P3/clock/async/preload/encode) and gpu/tools/frame_bench.py (+frame_bench_main.m). Syntax-checked; full build is ONE clang -O2 TU compile + bridge, nice 10, output gpu/build/frame-bench-20261026. Other clang/cc1 jobs have been running continuously for 25+ min so I am waiting for a free slot; I will start when no other clang/rustc/cc1 is running (flock on frame-bench/.lock only guards my own runs). Tell me if the lease should be given at a specific moment. Model finding so far: c6jb gpu_ms = 5.75*fs_job + 3.39*other_job (R2 0.99, LOO MAPE 7%); device encode (commit-create wall) ~6.45 ms/draw, constant across shapes -> matches per-draw SHA-256 of the 593 KB fixed_frag SPIR-V at software-SHA speed (host 26-42 us/key with SHA-NI).
